name: West Branch State Park Campground
evidence: Kept on the --AWH firsthand note (wooded loops, not on shoreline). Own reading, not applied: ODNR map (Rev 8/20) + leaf-off OSIP show lake-side pads about 20-35 m through thin woods from the shore, no road between; see flags.

name: Sunset Springs Campground
evidence: OSIP + Esri 10/26/2025: Fishing Lake is a small heart-shaped pond with island, ringed by a track, nearest RV rows ~85-100 m; swim lake is a small sand-ringed pool 100+ m from RVs; third pond ~120 m away in woods. No pad on any water.

name: Twin Acres Campground
evidence: OSIP + Esri 3/20/2023: dense trailer rows in woods; swim pond with beach to the north, nearest RVs ~45 m+ through trees and past a house; other ponds are on neighbouring land. Tree-screened, no pad on water.

name: Bluegrass Campground
evidence: OSIP + Esri 3/20/2023 (0.27 m/px): ~60 m pond wholly ringed by the loop road, no pad inside the loop; south row ~15-20 m and east rows ~30 m from water across that road. Road rules out pond, and a pond this small is not a lake, so lakeview does not fit (cf. 15432). South row occupancy differs between frames; nightly use not proven.

name: Chaparral Family Campground
evidence: Operator map: Lakeside sites 2-18 evens, pads 5-15 m over open bank, but all 9 occupied in Esri 3/11/2025 (season Apr 15-Nov 15) and in OSIP, so inferred seasonal. Sunrise 2-10 gravel pads, empty in both frames, are the likely nightly sites: ~80-120 m across lawn and the Lakeside road. Seasonal status is inferred, not operator-stated.

name: Cherokee Park Family Campground
evidence: OSIP + Esri 6/12/2025 + Wayback 2017-2026: on two ponds (north ~80x60 m), bank pads ~5-16 m from water with the loop road behind them; operator map shows rows around both. Occupancy of the east-bank pads changes between frames, but daily and seasonal rates are both sold and which pads sell nightly is unconfirmed, so pond not earned. A call to the park would settle it.

name: Lake Alma State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio per-site coords on OSIP: 066/067 (electric, 47 ft, web-bookable) sit on open lawn ~45-50 m from the cove's high-water edge, with park road and launch lawn between, so view at best; scattered road trees partly screen it. Sites 001-064 run up a shaded wooded hollow, no view. Lead's 70-90 m looks measured to drawn-down water.

name: Lake Cody Campground
evidence: Campspot park 5396 list (read for 2026-11-10) + its map: no mapped nightly site on the front row, which is 5-16 m from water but fully occupied pre-season in Esri 4/7/2025 (opens May 1) and OSIP, so seasonal. Mapped nightly rows are ~27-40 m back across loop road and front row, P1-P6 ~130 m+. 7 sites unmapped; lead's front-row claim contradicted.
